topic: File Explorer F1 Help behavior source recheck for D05

sources.title: Windows keyboard tips and tricks
sources.finding: Lists F1 as Help under common app shortcuts and warns that common shortcuts might not work in every app.
sources.limitation: Does not identify File Explorer or confirm its behavior on Windows 11 build 26300.

sources.title: F1 Opening browser help tabs that use to never do so
sources.finding: A 2022 answer reports that pressing F1 in File Explorer opens a help page in a browser.
sources.limitation: Community answer is not current product documentation and does not establish behavior on the target build.

targetVerification.target: Authorized disposable Windows 11 Pro target, build 26300 if available
requiredObservations: Pressing F1 with File Explorer active opens or does not open Help, recording the actual foreground window/process and URL if opened.
F1 behavior in at least one unrelated application remains unchanged by any proposed setting.
The proposed native TypeLib mapping is tested only after baseline behavior is recorded, with exact prior-state capture and restore.

disposition: Official guidance and community reports justify a targeted observation, but do not close current Windows 11 File Explorer behavior. Do not create a catalog operation or add it to the default profile until target behavior and an exact-restore implementation are verified.
